projectDescription: A full-stack MVP monorepo for managing an electronics store, featuring an Android client app, an Android operator scanner app, a Svelte web client, and a Pusher publisher microservice — all built on an offline-first, real-time architecture backed by Appwrite.
keyFeatures: Offline-first architecture with local persistence (Room on Android, Dexie/IndexedDB on web) and remote reconciliation via Appwrite
Real-time sale verification events delivered through Pusher, shared between Android client and web client
Secure Pusher event publishing via a dedicated Node.js/Express microservice (alejo_publisher) that isolates Pusher secrets
Multi-role support: customer-facing Android and web apps plus an operator Android app with QR scanning and sale confirmation
Feature-modular architecture (data / domain / presentation) shared across all surfaces through Kotlin shared modules
Google OAuth and email/password authentication backed by Appwrite
Product catalog with category filtering, offline browsing, and cart management
Sale lifecycle management: purchase/reservation → operator verification → real-time status update
Android APK delivery via GitHub Releases with guided download from the web app
publicApiSurface: POST /sale-verification/publish — Publish sale confirmed/rejected event to Pusher
SyncSalesCaseUse (shared-sale) — sync local pending sales with remote
UpdateSaleVerificationFromRealtimeCaseUse (shared-sale) — update local sale state from realtime event
CreateSaleCaseUse (web) — create sale from web client
